question: When you change something on a layer that already has keys, when should the change become a key?
context: Mocks: Prototype, Video, Animate with the overlay (http://127.0.0.1:8791/index.html#video-animate). The editor at the top draws option A and is live: move the playhead and drag or turn the title.

options.label: Always: any change keys itself
options.summary: Once a layer has a key, every change you make (dragging it, typing in the bar, the panel) puts a key at the playhead, and a property that was not animating joins with its own row. No switch to remember.
pros: Nothing to turn on: you click a key moment or move the playhead and change things
Matches what you described: tweak something and it is added to that key
cons: To move a whole animation somewhere else you must pick all its keys first
A change you meant for the whole clip makes a key instead
options.mitigation: Undo takes the key back in one step, and picking a row then dragging on the canvas moves every key of it together.

options.label: A record switch in the timeline bar
options.summary: A record button in the timeline bar, like Apple Motion. While it is on, changes become keys; while it is off, a change moves the value at every key by the same amount.
pros: Moving a whole animation is just a drag with record off
cons: A mode you have to notice: changes go wrong silently when it is in the wrong state
Another control in the timeline bar
options.mitigation: The button glows red and the bar fields show the key diamonds while it is on.

options.label: Only on a key moment
options.summary: A change becomes a key only while the playhead sits on one of the layer's key moments (or you clicked one). Anywhere else, a change moves the value at every key by the same amount.
pros: Easy to move a whole animation: park the playhead between keys and drag
cons: To add a key at a new time you must use Add Key first
Whether a drag keys or shifts depends on exactly where the playhead is
options.mitigation: The bar fields show a filled diamond when the change will key and a hollow one when it will shift.
